profile.description:
Seedream 5.0 Pro creates premium images from text prompts and reference images, with strong detail, composition, and multi-reference fusion. Use it for product concepts, style exploration, image edits, and polished visual assets across 1K and 2K output.

Input limits
- Up to 10 reference images
- One generated image is returned per request

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.

rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown:
**Seedream 5.0 Pro Pricing**

Billed per generated image. The first reference image is included; each additional reference image adds a small input-image charge. Layer separation bills every returned image, the base image and each layer, at its own tier.

| Tier | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------|------------|---------------|
| Output up to 2.61MP | $0.075/img | 2,500 pts/img |
| Output above 2.61MP | $0.150/img | 5,000 pts/img |
| Layer decomposition up to 2.61MP | $0.0375/img | 1,250 pts/img |
| Layer decomposition above 2.61MP | $0.0750/img | 2,500 pts/img |
| Extra input image after first | $0.005/img | 167 pts/img |
